title: Vampire Vape Cherry Tobacco 10ml Freebase E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape Cherry Tobacco Freebase delivers a distinctive twist on traditional Tobacco flavours. The earthy depth of Tobacco sets the foundation, while ripe Cherry adds a fruity depth and a touch of tart sweetness. The result is a balanced blend that combines the familiar richness of Tobacco with the vibrant edge of Cherry. Depending on nicotine strength, this e-liquid is blended at 40VG/60PG or 50VG/50PG, ensuring excellent flavour clarity and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Ideal for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping styles, it performs best with starter kits, vape pens, and refillable pod systems. Available in nicotine strengths from 0mg to 18mg, Cherry Tobacco offers versatility and flavour character to suit a wide range of vapers. Produced in the UK, Vampire Vape are trusted for their creativity and quality. Their Tobacco collection showcases refined blends that bring fresh perspectives to classic Tobacco notes.
